open_findings: No independent review of any module (MGR-07 not satisfied)
The blueprint's 374-item checklist remains NOT VERIFIED pending review; CHECKLIST_STATUS.md distinguishes test evidence from full acceptance
A basic lint/type/test CI workflow exists; deployment security, model lifecycle, data-governance and compliance controls remain unimplemented
Monthly orchestration uses synthetic single-asset GBM, exogenous prices and separate hedge accounts; conditional risk freezes holdings and rates
scope_enabled: Deterministic macro time engine: calendar, seeds, point-in-time data, shocks (PR-003)
Classical GBM/Heston and macro-conditioned (non-neural) path simulation (PR-004/009)
Delta and CVaR-trained MLP hedge simulation against synthetic paths (PR-007)
End-to-end demonstration and monthly StepHooks scenario with online delta/MLP hedging, conditional portfolio risk and evidence export (PR-011/014/015)
Government taxes/transfers/bonds and a scalar central-bank policy-rate agent (PR-012)
Single-firm labor/goods quantity clearing with ledger settlement (PR-013)
scope_prohibited: Live trading, order routing, or any connection to a brokerage
Use of real (non-synthetic) market or portfolio data
Any claim of regulatory, model-risk, or security certification

failure_modes: Synthetic single-asset GBM stress grid; no historical data, Heston/jumps or macro factorial.
Retraining replicates vary policy initialization and training data together, not separately.
Few independent seed levels can give unreliable percentile coverage; no exact guarantee.
Crossed resampling treats seed levels as independent draws and retains shared test banks.
Single-axis intervals/seed dispersions are conditional diagnostics, not variance components.
The endpoint averages cell CVaRs; it is not the CVaR of a pooled or ensemble portfolio.
Bonferroni allocates nominal tail error; it does not calibrate bootstrap marginal coverage.
Premium and delta pricing volatility stay at training assumptions under all stress scenarios.
model_cards.input_schema_summary: Per path per step: (log(S_t / strike), fraction of time-to-maturity remaining in [0, 1], previous holding in [-1, 1]), each a float32 scalar. Output: a tanh-bounded target holding in [-1, 1].
model_cards.intended_use: Research demonstration of CVaR-based deep hedging (Buehler et al. 2019) on synthetic single-asset European-option GBM paths. Not calibrated to, or validated against, real market data.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: Primary-scenario bank-averaged metrics for this one retraining. Study intervals resample training replicates and shared test banks; they are exploratory and do not establish exact coverage.
model_cards.model_type: Feedforward MLP hedging policy (3 inputs, 2 hidden layers of 32 units, tanh-bounded scalar output)
model_cards.prohibited_use: Any live trading, order routing, or real-money hedging decision. Any use outside the single-asset European vanilla call/put GBM setting it was trained on (not evaluated under Heston, jumps, multiple assets, or real market microstructure).
model_cards.training_data_summary: 2000 synthetic GBM paths (prometheus.stochastica.gbm), physical-measure, seed=1; no empirical/historical data. Policy seed=0.

study.decision_rule: All declared scenarios' crossed-bootstrap intervals must exceed the predeclared economic margin in the same direction; nominal Bonferroni tail allocation across scenarios
limitations: Synthetic single-asset GBM stress grid; no historical data, Heston/jumps or macro factorial.

Crossed resampling treats seed levels as independent draws and retains shared test banks.
Single-axis intervals/seed dispersions are conditional diagnostics, not variance components.
The endpoint averages cell CVaRs; it is not the CVaR of a pooled or ensemble portfolio.

Premium and delta pricing volatility stay at training assumptions under all stress scenarios.
study.resampling_method: pigeonhole percentile bootstrap of mean cell differences
